text: Tutankhamun Kaburu (KV62). KV62 be seka kɛ lala kaburuw la kodɔnlen ba ye u Kulu la, Howard Carter ka 1922 masakɛ denmisɛni kaburu yɛlmabali yeli yɔrɔ.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Sumalen nin masakɛ kaburuw tɔw ye, nka, Tutankhamun kaburu lajɛli nafan ma bɔn kosɛbɛ, nin a ka tɔgɔya ani nin masiri fitini ye.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Mɔgɔ min be fɛ ka kɔlɔlɔ min kɛra sumaralen ye a ɲɛna waatimina o y'a ɲinin ka ta ka bɔ ka kɛsu kɔnɔ nimisa tɛna wasa  bari kunkolo ani kamakunw dɔrɔn de be ye
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Kaburu warimanfɛnw ɲuman nininw t'a kɔnɔ tuguni, nka a tara ka ta Egyptie mize kɔnɔ Caire.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Lajɛlibaw waati caman tɛ minunw bolo kan ka waati tɛmɛ yɔrɔ wɛrɛla.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, kilomɛtiri duuru  Siem Reap worodugu ani tileben yanfan fɛ. O kulusanfɛla tanpulu kun jɔla siyɛkili 9 laban na, Masakɛ Yasovarman ka fanga kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Tanpulu yɛlɛ ani nisondiya cogo ani  Tonle Sap Lake lajɛli be kulu yɛlɛ in kɛ fɛn nafama.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: O yɔrɔ lajɛli be seka fara ɲɔgɔnkan lafiyala nin batɔɔn woyazi ye ka ta laki la.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass mako kabɔn ka dn tanpulu kɔnɔ, ola kana ɲina kana n'i ka pasipɔri ye i fɛ nin be ka ta Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jesusalem ye Israel faba ani tugu ba ye, ali na sɔrɔ jamana tɔw ani Diɲɛforobatɔnba ma sɛbɛntiya fɔlɔ inafɔ Israel faba.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Dugu kɔrɔ Jude Kulu sanfɛ ka tariku ye kabakoman ye min ta bayiri kaw la.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Dugu in ye dinɛ sabaw minunw Maa kelen kofɔ dinemayɔrɔ - Ziwifuya. Kiretiyɛnla ani Silamɛya, ani b'inafɔ tasili, diɲɛ ani seko nin dɔnko kɛ yɔrɔ.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Ko sababu ko kɛ dugu in dinɛ nafan ye ani kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala Dugu Kɔrɔ mara yɔrɔ camaw, Jerusalem ye Israel lajɛli kɛ yɔrɔ baw dɔla kelen ye.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Tariku, fuyeli ani seko ni dɔnko yɔrɔ camaw be Jerusalem, nin a sani kɛ yɔrɔw falen ba ani makananw, kafeminw yɔrɔw ani dumunikɛyɔrɔw ye.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Equateur b'a jagoya Cuba dugudenw ka weleli sɛbɛn sɔrɔ yani u ka dɔn Equateur kɔnɔ diɲɛ ayeropɔriw fɛ walima duguma siraw danw fɛ.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: O sɛbɛn in kan ka legalize Equateur Kɔfɛ Ko Ɲɛnɛbɔba Minisiriso fɛ, ani be tugu fɛn dɔw la.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: U jagoya fɛnw ninunw dabɔra ka taka seginw dilan senkan jamana fila ni ɲɔgɔncɛ.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Cuba jamanadenw Ameriki Green Card be minunw bolo kan ka tagabɔ Equateur lasigidenso la walasa ka jɛn  sɔrɔ  kabɔ nin laɲini in ma.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: I ka pasipɔri kan ka da,ga kalo 6 ka tɛmɛ i ka woyazi waatiw kan. Tani ka segin/tali tike mako beyi k'i ka toli janya jira pirewu jira.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Turuw ka ɲɔgɔ nin kulubaw ye, ola nin nin i be kelen na walima nin terikɛ kelen ye, a ɲinin i ka mɔgɔ tɔw dɔn ani ka mɔgɔ naani walima wɔɔrɔ kulu dɔ dilan walasa ka mɔgɔ kelen piri ɲuman sɔrɔ.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Nka, o manka kɛ jɔrɔnan koye bari waaticamana turusiw be kɛɲɔgɔn kan ka mɔbili fa.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: A be komi sinsin o cogo ka mɔgɔ kumayɛlɛma ka jir'ula u kan ka waari cama sara.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Jolila Machu Picchu kɔkɔdugu yanfan sanfɛla dan na ye nin yɛlɛka jigin kulu in ye, waatidɔwla fotow kɔfɛla ja yɔrɔtɔw ye.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: A kabɔn ka tɛmɛ dɔni nin dugumalala, ani a yɛlɛli ka gɛlɛya ani a jaleno, nka famuyali cogola mɔgɔ kɛnɛmaw kan ka seka yɛlɛ miniti 45 boɲɔgɔngo kɔnɔ.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Senbila kabakuruw bilaleno sira bɛɛ la, ani digɛn ma yɔrɔw la juru nɛgɛla maw beyi ka minɛ tikɛla.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: O fɔlen kɔ, sigi a kan k'i nɛnɛgiri bena durun ani i janto digɛndɔn ma yɔrɔw la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala nin u ɲikin neno, bari a be seka kɛ farati ye teliyala.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Kulu dɔnda fitinini dɔ be kulu sanfɛlara min tɛmɛ kan ka kɛ min fɛ, a ka surun kosɛbɛ ani a ka dɔkɔ.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Galapagos nin yɔrɔw ani kunkow yeli kaɲi ka tɛmɛ batɔn de la, cogomina inafɔ Charles darwin y'a kɛ cogomina san 1835 kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Lajɛlikɛbatɔn min ka nin 60 ye de be boli Galapagos jiw kan - k'o boɲan daminɛ mɔgɔ 8 ka ta bila mɔgɔ 100 talila.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Mɔgɔ camaw b'u sigiyɔrɔ minɛ ka bila waatijan ka bila (Komi batɔnw falen be kɛ waaticamana lajɛli gani waatila).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: I d'ala k'i be i tike ta baarakɛla min fɛ ye Galapagos dɔnba jɔnjɔn ye nin batɔn suguya camaw dɔniya ye.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: O b'a to i be fɛla kɛrɛnkɛrɛnew  ani/walima balinaw be ta nin batɔnw ye minunw b'o jateminɛ.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Yani Ɛsipaɲɔliw nali cɛ siyɛkili 16 kɔnɔ, Chilie kɔkɔdugu yanfan kun be Incaw ka mara kɔnɔ tumamina Araucanians sigibaw (Mapuche) kun sigilen Chilie camancɛra ani worodugu yanfan fɛ.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche kun ye fɛnɛ Ameriki sigiden kulu laban yɛrɛ maralaw dɔ ye, min kun ma seka minɛ ka dɔn Ɛpaɲɔli fɔrɔyɔrɔ maraw kɔn fo Chilie ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya talen kɔ.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Ali na sɔrɔ Chilie y'a ka yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya fɔ san 1810 (Napoleon ka kɛlɛw waatila min Ɛsipaɲi to gofɛrɛneman tan san fila kɔnɔ), sebaya jɔnjɔn kun ma seka sɔrɔ Ɛsipaɲɔli sanfɛ fo san 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republic ya Dominica (Spanish: Republica Dominicana) ni bũrũri wa Caribbean ũrĩa ũkoragwo nuthu-inĩ ya irathĩro island ya Hispaniola, mahakanite na Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Thengĩa icua cia mĩthanga mierũ na mĩarĩro ya ĩrĩma, bũrũri ũcio warĩ mũciĩ kũrĩ athũngũ arĩa a tene mũno Amerika, ĩrĩa rĩu rĩ thĩinĩ wa Santa Domingo
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Island  ĩyo yaikarĩtwo nĩ mĩhĩrĩga ya Ataino na Akaribe. Akaribe marĩ adũ maaragia mwario wa Arawakan arĩa makinyĩte kũu ĩhida rĩa 10,000 BCE
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Thĩinĩ wa mĩaka mĩnini kuuma gũkinya kwa mũthũngũ mũguturi, ũingĩ wa andũ wa mũhĩrĩga wa Atiaino nĩwanyihĩtio mũno nĩ Aspania atahi
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Kũringana na Fray Bartolomé las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) gatagatĩ ka mwaka wa 1492 na 1498 atahi a Spain nĩmoragĩte andũ ta 100,000 rũrĩrĩ-inĩ rwa Ataino.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union. Nin yɔrɔ in dilana inafɔ masabɔndayɛlɛlen siyɛkili 17 dine yɔrɔ fɛ, minunw na Templo de San Diego kelen dɔrɔn de ye so balolen ye.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: A be baara bibi in na inafɔ jamankafoyɔrɔ, ani fɛn dɔ be ka kɛ yi waatibɛɛla, su ni tile.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Dumuni kɛyɔrɔ dama damaniw be zariden gɛrɛfɛlara, ani tileganiw fɛ ani sufɛ konsɛriw fulama be kɛ yi kabɔ Central Gazebo fɛ.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Balokɔn fila tilanlen nin santimɛtiri 69 ye kanu mɔgɔ kɔrɔ do ka so ye.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Nin waariminsɛni dama damani ye, denmisɛni dɔw bena tariku f'i ye.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Gun ye tile woyazi kodɔnlen ye walima dɔkɔkun boli min kayaki, kululayɛlɛ, butukiw, dumuni kɛyɔrɔw ani fɛn camaw bil'aw ka bolo kan.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Kulu yɛrɛ yɛrɛ be Howe Sound kɔnɔ, Vancouver kɔfɛ dɔrɔn, ani ta ka di ni jisanfɛ takisi bolodalen ye kabɔ Grandville Island ka Vancouver dugukɔnɔna.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔ min be kɛnɛma baaraw fɛ, tama ka ta Sea ani Sky kɔnɔna sirafɛ nafan kabɔn.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (lɛri 1 ni miniti 30 boli kabɔ Vancouver) ka gɛlɛ nka kodɔnleno ko sababu kɛ 2010 Winter Olympics ye.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Nɛnɛ waatila, siki kɛ yɔrɔ ɲuman dɔw Ameriki Kɔkɔdugu Yanfan fɛ jabɔ, ani tilema fɛ kulusanfɛ nɔkɔsoboli yɛrɛ yɛrɛ dɔw lajɛ.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Sɛbɛn kan ka ɲinin ka mara ka kɔn. I kan ka dɔni sɛbɛn sɔrɔ ka su kɛ Sirana kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ye lakɛli sigiyɔrɔ kelen dɔrɔn de yemin be siyɔrɔ di ani dumuni kalamaw kafara sigili kan. La Leona, San Pedrillo ani Los patos be sigiyɔrɔ dɔrɔn de di nka dumuni tɛyi.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Pariki dɔn sɛbɛn be seka minɛkabila jɔna jɔna Ranger Station la Puerto Jimenez kɔnɔ, nka u tɛ sɔn juru karitiw la.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Park Service (MINAE) tɛ pariki dɔni sɛbɛn di ka tɛmɛ kalo kelen kan yani nali waaticɛ.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol be sɛbɛni minɛnikaliba baara kɛ dolari 30 la, walima dolali 10 nin tile kelen sɛbɛn ye; kunafoniw tɔw b'u Corcovado pazi kan.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Cook Islands ye gun jamana ye min tugulen yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyala Nouvelle Zelande la, be Polynesie, Ocean Pacific worodugu yanfan camancɛla.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: O ye gun kuluw ye min ye gun 15 ye min yɛrɛkɛleno kɔkɔji sanfɛyɔrɔ kilomɛtirikare 2.2 sanfɛ.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Nin waatibɔnda kelen nin Hawai ye, gun ninunw be miri inafɔ "Hawai tukuma yɔrɔ".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Ali na sɔrɔ a togɔ, a be lajɛkila kɔrɔbalen hakilijigi hawai la yani ka kɛ jamana ye ani yani turusi ɔtɛli ba ani taɲɛ wɛrɛw cɛ.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Dugu tɛ Cook Island nka a dilan neno ni gun 15 ye. Gun belebelebaw ye Rarotonga ani Aitutaki ye.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Jamana minunw talenoɲɛ bibi in na, dilan ɲuman ba ani daraka yɛlɛna ka kɛ ari cogoyaye.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Sanfɛ yɔrɔ dan na, B&B be fasafili  tiɲɛla fɛnw fila dɔrɔn na: dilan ani daraka.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: O cogoyala, o cogoɲuman ba la nin yɔrɔ suguw be seka dilan ɲuman ba sɔrɔ, lala tikɛdilane nin filiw ye walima fɔlɔfɔlɔ dilan.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Daraka ye lala marayɔrɔ waati nisondiya dumuniw ye walima jiginso dumuni kɛrɛnkɛrɛniye.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Yɔrɔ be seka kɛ fɔlɔfɔlɔ so kɔrɔlen nin fɔlɔ so masiriw ye, dugumakolo desɛnma ani pisini.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Ka dɔn i ka mɔbili kɔnɔ ani k'a woyazi sira jan dɔ ta be kɔnɔna nɔgɔya wele.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Mɔbili baw kontirɛri, lala i degin neno ala kaban k'i ka mobili boli ani k'a danw dɔ.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Tanti sigili wali yɔrɔla walima dugu dɔ kɔnɔ be seka mɔgɔ ɲɛsin i ma nɔgɔyala.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Kuma surun na, i ka mɔbili natili ye cogoyaɲuman ye k'a woyazi jan kɛ nka "kɔlisigili" ka gɛlɛ.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Mobili jɔlensigili be seka kɛ nin mobili kɔnɔfɛrɛlen ba b'i bolo, SUV, Sedan walima Wagon Station nin sigiyɔrɔw minunw be kari.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Tiɲɛ be otɛli dɔw bolo kabɔ sisi tirɛnbolisiraw ani mɔgɔtabatɔnw waati dɔn ma na; yani Diɲɛ Kɛlɛba filana cɛ, siyɛkili 19 ani siyɛkili 20 daminɛna.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Nin otɛliw kun ye yɔrɔ ye famaw ani mɔgɔ kodɔnlenw kun jigin yɔrɔmina ani kun be waatidɔw la sura ɲuman dɔn walima sufɛgitan kɛ.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Ɛnsitalasiyɔn kɔ kɔrɔw, ekipeman labanw tanya ani kɔrɔli suguya dɔ y'u kɛcogo ye.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Ali na sɔrɔ waaticamana u be ta mɔgɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛniw fɛ, u be kɛ waatidɔw la jamana ɲɛmɔgɔw walima mɔgɔba wɛrɛw jiginyɔrɔ ye.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Woyazikɛla min be yala nin waari mugu ye be seka diɲɛ turu kelen jateminɛ, min tilaneno jɔyɔrɔ fitiniw cɛ nin otɛliw camaw na.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Jatigiya falen falen erezo ye ɔriganizasiyɔn ye min woyazikɛlaw ani dugu mɔgɔw u be ka min lajɛ tukuɲɔkɔn na.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Sendɔnlila o erezo ɲɔgɔn nana b'a laɲinin dɔrɔn i ka ɛntɛrɛnɛti sanfɛ sɛbɛn dɔ dafa; ali na sɔrɔ erezo dɔw be sɛgɛsɛgɛli wɛrɛ laɲinin.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Dunanjigina labilalenw ka lisi be d'ima ola walima sɛbɛn cogoyala ani/walima ɛntɛrɛnɛti sanfɛ, waatidɔw la nin kunafoniw ye ani ɲɛfɔli kabɔ woyazikɛra wɛrɛ yɔrɔ.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Fotɛyijisanfɛpani daminɛna Zanwuyekalo 2004 tumamina ɔridinatɛri porogaramu kɛla Casey Fenton ye cogoya nɔgɔmani sɔrɔ ka ta Islande nka ma sigiyɔrɔ sɔrɔ ka to yen.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: A ye emɛyili bataki lakolidenw ma mara sanfɛkalansola ani jaabi caman baw sɔrɔ siyɔrɔ furama sɔrɔ siratigɛ.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Dunajiginyɔrɔ be dumuni di fɔlɔ denmisɛniw ma - duna min be san mukan kɔnɔ - nka i be seka woyazi kɛla kɔrɔbalenw sɔrɔyen fɛnɛ.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Duw nin denmisɛniw ye yeli ka dɔgɔ, nka dunajiginyɔrɔ dɔw b'a to ka dɔn suɲɛkɔnɔ kɛrɛnkɛrɛnlen kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Beijing dugu Siniwajamana kɔnɔ bena kɛ Olymic Winter Games san 2022 kun bɛ baga ye, min bena kɛ dugu fɔlɔ ye min be tilema ani nɛnɛ zuye olɛnpiki kun bɛ.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing bena dayɛlɛli ani tuguli tulɔnkɔ kun bɛ ani sɔkɔnɔna gilasi zuyew.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Sikiboli zuye wɛrɛ bena kɛ Taizicheng sikilkɛ yɔrɔla Zhandgjiakou kɔnɔ kilomɛtiri 200 ɲɔgn nin Beijing cɛ.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Tanpuluw camaw be San Fɛti kɛ ka daminɛ Nowanburukalo laban na ka ta bila Mɛkalo camancɛ la, min be falen ka da tanpulu kelen kelena bɛɛ ka waatijateminɛcogola.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Tanpulu camaw ka fɛtiw be kɛ inafɔ tanpulu ka aniwɛrisɛri walima Maa dɔ bangeli o kumu kɔnɔ walima tulɔnbaaraw wɛrɛw minw tugulen tanpulula.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Keraa tanpulu fɛtiw lajɛli nafan ka bɔn, nin sama masirili, tanpulu fɔlikɛɛlaw ani nisondiyawɛrɛw.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Diɲɛ Sugu dɔ (kodɔnlen inafɔ World Eɲposition walima Expo dɔrɔn) ye diɲɛ ariw ani dɔniyaw ka fɛti ye.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Jamana minunw bo sendo ala be catiri ani kalan tulɔnkɛw jira yɛlɛmali so kɔnɔ ka diɲɛ kunbalanw jira walima u ka dugu tabolo ani tariku.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: International Horticultural Expositions ye baara kɛrɛnkɛrɛni ye min filɛriw jira, filɛri zaridenw ani fɛnw fɛn nin o be taga nin jiriw ye.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Ali na sɔrɔ hakilinanala, u be seka kɛ san un san (fo nin a be kɛ jamana camaw na), tiɲɛla u tɛ kɛ.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Nin baara ninunw be kɛ nɔrɔmalila kalo saba ani wɔɔrɔ nin ɲɔgɔncɛ, ani be kɛ yɔrɔ minunw man dɔgɔ ka tɛmɛ ɛkitari 5o kan.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Filimu cogoya camaw beyi minunw natila san cama tɛmɛni kɔnɔ. Filimu nɔrɔmali 35 (36 nin 24 milimɛtiri negatiwu ye) ye kodɔnlen ba ye.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: A beka falen fitini dɔrɔn nin a bana, ani be rezolisiyɔn di min be seka suma nin sisan DSLR ye.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Filimu fɔrima fitini kamera dɔw be 6 nin 6 cm fɔrima itilize, kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala 56 nin 56 mm negatiwu.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: O resolisiyɔn di min be 35 mm negatiwu siyɛn naani bɔ (3136 mm2 nin 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Kunkokɔnɔna be fototaw jɛla min ka gɛlɛ kosɛbɛ fototalama ma, ani mako be gɛrizigɛ, muɲu, ɛkisiperiyansi ani baaraminunw faralen ye ɲɔgɔnkan na.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Kunkokɔnɔna fotota be jateminɛ fɛn nɔgɔ ye, nka inafɔ fotota bakurubala, foto be daɲɛ ba kelenw bɔ kɔrɔla.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Kunkokɔnɔna fotota be waatidɔw la yɔrɔjanfototana ɲinin, ali na sɔrɔ fɛnw inafɔ kɔnɔ kuluw walima dantan fitini dɔw mako be kunkolo wɛrɛw la.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Kunkokɔnɔ baganɲ camaw sɔrɔli ka gɛlɛ, ani sariya be parikiw kɔnɔ waatidɔw la ka ɲɛsin fototama fereli siratigɛw fɛ.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Kunkokɔnɔ bagan be seka maloya walima ka fariya. Nɛnɛ, funteni be seka kɛ yɔrɔla walima be beka gɛlɛya.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Diɲɛ kanw ka nin 5000 ye, nin min fɔbaga ka ca nin mɔgɔ miliyɔn 20 ani 50 ye walima min ka ca nin o ye.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Daɲɛ sɛbɛniw famuya kadi waatidɔw la nɔgɔyala nin daɲɛ fɔlen ye fɛnɛ. O ye diɲɛ ye kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala nin yɔrɔ tɔw ye, minunw fɔli ko ɲuman ka gɛlɛ waatidɔw la.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Jamana dɔw mɔgɔw be angilɛ fɔ kaɲɛ cogoɲuman bala, ani ali na sɔrɔ i be seka a dɔni dalen ye - kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala denmisɛniw cɛla..
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Miri, n'i sɔna, Manchester duguden, Boston duguden, Jamaique duguden, ani Sydney duguden sigilen tabali gɛrɛfɛ ka suradɔn dumuni kɛyɔrɔ dɔ la Toronto kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: U be ɲɔgɔn nisondiya nin nzirinw ye kabɔ u ka duguw la, min ka fɔ u kanw fɔcogow la ani nin u ka dugu kuma kɛrɛnkɛrɛnlenw ye.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Dumuni sani sipɛrimarisela ye waaticama sira nɔgɔma ka balo. Nin tobili ɲɛ tɛka sɔrɔ, o la sugandili dan ye dumuni dilaninw ka ban.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Taɲɛkumana, sipɛrimarisew be seka dumuni dilaninw ka ban yɔrɔ camaw bila sekan. Dɔw b'ali furudeni walima cogoya wɛrɛw ka dumuni kalaya di.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Dugu walima butiki dɔw la, dumuni kɛyɔrɔ kelen dɔ be sɔrɔyi, waatidɔw la kodɔnbali dɔ sariya siratigɛ piri danɔgɔla,
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: I ka kontira ani kontira wele kunafoniw dilan ani k'u bila i kun ka yala.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: U mako be ka asuransi ka imeyili jira ani nɛgɛjuruw jira ladilikanw, jɛnw ani laɲiniw siratigɛ fɛ.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Sɛbɛn kopi kelen bila i ka walizi kɔnɔ ani ɛntɛrɛnɛti sanfɛ (imɛyili bataki c'i yɛrɛ ma nin tugulanw ye, walima a mara "kabanɔkɔ" kɔnɔ).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Nin be seka woyaze nin ɔridinatɛri walima tabilɛti ye, sɛbɛn kopi dɔ mara memuwari kan walima disiki (min be sɔrɔ ali ni ɛntɛrɛnɛti tɛ).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Kontara sɛbɛn kelen fɛnɛ di i woyazi kɛɲɔgɔnw ma ani balimaw walima tɛriw so minunw b'a fɛ ki dɛmɛ.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Minɛn (min dɔnlen fɛnɛ inafɔ minɛn) man fari te dancogola, nka bena u yɛrɛ defan nin u ye farati ye.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Nin mɔgɔw ma minɛn ye inafɔ lala farati fɛn, u bena gɛrɛ a la ka damatɛmɛ kosbɛ ani k'u yɛrɛw bila faratila.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Alikɔlimanfɛn min hakɛyala. Alikɔ tɛ mɔgɔw bayɛlɛma cogoya kelena, ani i dandɔli nafan kabɔn kosɛbɛ.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Keneya kunbalan kuntagalajan sɔrɔli alikɔli minli damatɛmɛ wale fɛ be seka kɛ fogofogo cɛnliye ani ali fiyɛn ani saya. Farati be taɲɛ min be alikɔli kɔniw min.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Jama jama camaw be seka sɔrɔ sipiriti kɔnlenw la minunw be seka kɛ metanɔli ye, min be seka fiyɛn nati walima saya ali a fitini minli.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Lunɛtiw sɔkɔn be seka nɔgɔya kofɛ jamana dɔ kɔnɔ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala jamana minunw kɔnɔ sɔrɔ ka dɔgɔ yɔrɔ minunw na baarakɛ waari ka nɔgɔ.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: A jateminɛ ka ɲɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛliw kɛ i ka jamana la, kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala nin asiransi b'a ta, ani nan'i ka ɔridiansi ye i fɛ fan bɛɛ la.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Kunbalan fila be ariki tɔgɔbaw minunw be sɔrɔ yɔrɔ sugu ninunw la; o dɔw be seka ladegi ye, ani ɲuman ɲuman `minunw bena kabɔ kɔfɛ daka gɛlɛ lala ka tɛmɛ jamana kɔnɔ taw kan.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kafe ye diɲɛ feere fɛn dɔ ye min be feere ka tɛmɛ, ani lala i be seka suguyaw camaw sɔrɔ i ka maara la.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Nka o bɛɛ na ta, kafe mlin cogo sugaya camaw beyi diɲɛ kɔnɔ min be lajɛli kun bɔ.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Bolili kulufulancɛ jira sanfɛ (walima bolili kulufulancɛɛ jira sanfɛ) ye ka kulu dugumalara, min be seka ja walima faleno jila.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Bolili kulufulancɛ jira sanfɛ be nɔnili, yɛlɛli ani pani fɛnw faraɲɔgɔnkan - nka mako be antirɛneman dɔni na walima forimu walasa ka daminɛ (sumanila nin kulula yɛlɛli ye, jila filili walima kulula siki, misalila).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Tama yɛlɛ ye kɛrɛma farikoloɲɛjɛ ye min ye ka tama kunkokɔnɔnaw la, waatidɔw la tama wotorow kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Tilefɛtama ye kilomɛtiri kelen walima min ka jan nin o ye yɔrɔw tamaw min be seka tama dile kelen kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Tile tama sira ɲɔgɔn ma gɛrɛfɛ mako labɛniw dɔni na, ani mɔgɔ min galabu ka kɛnɛ hakɛyala be sek'o kɛ nisondiyala.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Denbayaw nin den fitiniw ye mako be lala labɛn camaw la, nka tile kelen kɛrɛma ɲɛnɛjɛbaaraw be seka kɛ nɔgɔyala ali nin denw ye ani denmisɛni minunw be zariden na.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Diɲɛ fan bɛɛ, bolikɛ kuluw 200 ɲɔgɔn de beyi. u cama be marise nin u yɛrɛ ye.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: The Global Running Tours nɔnbila, Go Running Tours be baara kɛ nin kɛbaw tani dama damaniw ye kontian naani bɛɛ kɔnɔ.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Nin ju ye Bacelonas Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, Running Tours Prague min sinisinleno Prague ani dɔ wɛrɛw ye sendɔ ala jɔna jɔna.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Fɛnw camaw beyi i kan ka min jateminɛ yani and tumamina i be ka woyase ka ta yɔrɔ dɔ la.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Nin i be woyase, sigi a kana kow tɛna kɛ inafɔ "so". Kɛjogow, sariyaw, dumuni, sirasariyaw, siyɔrɔ ani baloco sariyaw, kan ani dɔ wɛrɛ tɛna kɛ inafɔ i kun be yɔrɔ mina cogoyala.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: O ye fɛn ye i kan ka min bila i kun na, ka jigifabaliya bali walima lala ali yɔrɔ ko kɛ cogow kanu baliya.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Woyasi azansiw kun beyi kabini siyɛkili 19 na. Woyasi ɲɛnɛbɔba baarakɛla ye waatidɔw la latigɛ ɲuman ye woyasi o kumu kɔnɔ min be woyasikɛla ka yɔrɔ lajɛli tɛmɛniw ɲɛ, tabolo, kan walima jamana minunw sɔrɔ da dɔgɔ.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Ali na sɔrɔ azansi camaw be fɛka yɔrɔmara nɔrɔmaliw kɛɛ, woyasi ɲɛnɛbɔba baarakɛla camaw b'u yɛrɛw sipesiyalize kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala woyasi suguya dɔw kan, waaribɔta filancɛ walima lajɛɛkikɛyɔrɔ.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: A kaɲi ka tɛmɛ woyasi ɲɛnɛbɔba baarakɛla dɔ fɛ min maraliw woyaziw o kumu kɔnɔ minunw nin ta ye kelen ye.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: A lajɛ woyasi ɲɛnɛbɔba baarakɛla beka min purosiyɔn kɛ, nin siti dɔ sanfɛlala walima butiki dɔ finɛtiri la.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Nin i be fɛka diɲɛ ye nɔgɔyala, fɛn nafan dɔ kama, balolocogo walima yɛrɛkɔrɔbɔ, cogoya camaw beyi k'o kɛ.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Kumafɔlila, u be dɔn kuluw fila kɔnɔ: walima ka baara kɛ nin i be woyase walima a ɲinin ka dansigi i ka waaridɔnta la. Nin sɛbɛn in be sinsin nin laban in kuna.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Nin mininw be fɛka jɛn lafiya kɔ, waati ani jateminɛlajɛli ka waaribɔtaw ɲɔnti ka jigi fo fu masurunyala, waari fitini woyasi lajɛ.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Ladilikan b'a jigiya ko waoyasikɛlaw mankan suyɛnlikɛ, dansagoli, sendɔn suku kɔnlen dɔ la, delili walima cogoya wɛrɛ la ka min mɔgɔw la u ka nafan kama.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Siginfɛli fuyɛli kɛyɔrɔ ye waaticamana jɔ yɔrɔ fɔlɔ tumamina jigili bɛka kɛ pankuru kɔnɔ, batɔn walima bolimanfɛn wɛrɛ.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Furɔntiyɛri dɔw la, tirɛ kontureliw be kɛ tirɛ bolitɔ ani i kan karididantite ɲuman bila i kun tumamina i bena dɔ nin tirɛn  ninunw la kelen kɔnɔ.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Sufɛ tirɛnw minunw dabɔla sunɔkɔ kama, tirɛ bolila be seka pasipɔriw faraɲɔgɔnkan walalsa i ka sunɔgɔ kana tikɛ.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Tɔgɔsɛbɛnli ye laɲinin wɛrɛ ye wiza sɔrɔli siratamala.Jamana dɔw la, i kan k'i ka piresansi kɔfɛ ani yɔrɔmina i bena tɔyi adirɛsi nin maarayɔrɔ famaw ye.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: U mako be lala sɛbɛn dɔ dafalila maarayɔrɔ polisisola walima talila imigirsiyɔn baarakɛyɔrɔw la.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Jamana camaw kɔnɔ, nin ni sariya sigu ye, maarayɔrɔ otɛliw be tɔgɔsɛbɛni sɛbɛn ko ɲɛnɛbɔ (jatemina ka ɲinin).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Cogoya wɛrɛw la, mɔgɔw minunw jigileno yɔrɔw turisiw ka sigiyɔrɔw kɔfɛ de dɔrɔn kan ka tɔgɔsɛbɛni kɛ.Nka, o be sariya kɛ dibila fɛn ye, ola a ɲininkadɔn kabila.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arisitɛciri sinsinleno sow desɛni ani jɔlila kuna. Yɔrɔ dɔ dilancogo ye waaticamana turisi samanan ye a cogola.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Sankasojanw camaw lajɛliw cɛkaɲi ani lajɛli kabɔ sankasojanw dɔ sanfɛlala walima kabɔ finɛtiri dɔla min pozisiyɔn kaɲi be seka kɛ fɛn cɛɲuman ye ka lajɛ.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arisitɛkiciri be doro cogoyala nin kalanbɔnda dɔw ye inafɔ dugudilani cogoya, sojɔ kalanw, masiri kalanw, sokɔnɔna dilani ani sokɔfɛla pilan dilani.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: kadakan kaɲakɔnɔnaw janya kan, i tɛ seka na sufɛ tulɔn cama sɔrɔ nin ta Albuquerque walima Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Nka, kazino minunw bɛɛ tɔgɔfɔla sanfɛ be mininfenw feere, ani u camaw be ɲɛnɛcɛ mariki tɔgɔ dɔ nati (Fɔlɔfɔlɔ bele belebaw be Albuquerque ani Sanfe gɛrɛfɛ).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Janto ala: dugu fitiniw bariw yan tɛ waatibɛɛ yɔrɔ ɲumanw ye ka ɲɛsin lajɛlikɛla dunaw ma.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Kuma kelen, kunbalan ba be Nouvelle Mevique nin mɔbili bolila sulen ye, ani a mɔbili bolila sulenw hakɛya ka surun kosɛbɛ dugu fitini barimanw la.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Kokola desɛnw ani Sɛbɛniw dagan bali kodɔnleno inafɔ girafiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Hali na sɔrɔ o tɛ ko kura ye, mɔgɔ camaw ba tugu lala denmisɛnniw la minunw b'a dabɔ a kama ka foroba ani mɔgɔw ka yɔrɔw cɛn nin pɛtiri fiyɛta itilizeli ye.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Nka, bibi in na girafiti kɛlaw kodɔnlenw, girafiti tulɔnkɛbaaraw ani kokow "dagalenw" beyi, Girafiti desɛnw nin sira in fɛ boleno waatidɔw la desɛnbaaraw fɛ ka tɛmɛ  etikɛti kɔnlenw kan.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Boomerang filili ye se kodɔnlen ye turisiw camaw be fɛka min kalan.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Nin i be fɛka boomerang filili kalan min be segin kana i tikɛ kɔnɔ, i dala ko boomerang ɲuman b'i bolo min be segin.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Boomerang camaw min be sɔrɔ Ɔsitirali tɛ boomerang segin ta ye. Degilikɛla kuraw man ka ɲinin ka filili kɛ fiyɛn ba la.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Hangi Meal be tobi digɛn dun dɔ kɔnɔ dugukolo jukɔrɔ.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Hangi be labaara waatidɔw la ka ladala sura cɛnini dilan.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi be itilize waatidɔw la ka ladala sura cɛnini dilan.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Yɔrɔ camaw Rotorua kɔnɔ be digɛn kalama nin dugufutɛnti ye di tumamina nin digɛn kalama dɔw be seka sɔrɔ Christchurch, Wellington kɔnɔ ani yɔrɔ wɛrɛw.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Kulu fila be MetroRail ka baarakɛyɔrɔ taa tirɛn la Capte Town kɔnɔ ani a kɔfɛ: MetroPlus (min be wele fɛnɛ Kulu fɔlɔ) ani Metro (min wele ko Kulu Sabana).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Metroplus lafiyakabɔn ani tɛ fa ka damatɛmɛ nka daga gɛlɛn dɔni, ali na sɔrɔ ka nɔgɔ ka tɛmɛ meturo tike nɔrɔmali Erɔpu kɔnɔ.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: MetropPlus ani Metro kɔlɔsilibaw be tirɛn bɛɛ kɔnɔ; MetroPlus kɔlɔsilikɛlaw be waatibɛɛ tirɛn dan na Cape Town gɛrɛfɛ.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Tɔw ka walisiw tali - Kan'i ka minɛnw fiyɛn i ɲɛ t'u ye yɔrɔmina, kɛrɛnkɛniyala tumamina i beka jamanaw furɔntiyɛriw tigɛ.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: I be se kana i yɛrɛ sɔrɔ nin durɔgu ye ka sɔrɔ i ma bɔ a kalama, min bena i dɔn kunbalan baw la.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: O ye ka kɔnɔli kɛ aran na, inafɔ durɔgu kasama wuluw be seka itilize waatibɛɛ la ka sɔrɔ i t'a kalama.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Jamana dɔw ka ɲangiliw ka fari ka dama tɛmɛ ali nin sariyasɔsɔ fɔlɔw lo; o seka kɛ san 10 kaso ye walima si kaso.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Minɛnw bolobololen ye zɔnw ka sibulu ye ani be seka fɛnɛ famaw sɔnmu janya kɔsilila kabɔ bɔmu faratiw ma.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: So, ko sababu kɛ waatibɛɛ bilali ye maarayɔrɔ banakisɛ la, a ka c'ala i lakana neno kabɔ nin bana ninunw ma.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Nka diɲɛ fan dɔw fɛ, yɔrɔmina kunkokɔnɔ ye kura y'i ɲɛna, a ka c'ala kosɛbɛ i bana kunbalanw sɔrɔ.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Yɔrɔ kalamaw la banakisɛw be bugun fɛnɛ teliyala ani be balo waatijan la farikolo kɔfɛ.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Ola, Delhi Belly Kunbalanw, Pharaon ka Daga, Montezuma ka Tasarali ani u ter wɛrɛw.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Inafɔ nɛnɛkirila kunbalanw yɔrɔ sumaniw la, kɔnɔna kunbalanw yɔrɔ kalamaw la ka ca ani cogoya camaw la be mɔgɔw tɔrɔ nka tɛ farati ye.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: In i beka woyase ka ta jamana dewelopeni dɔ la siyɛnfɔlɔla - walima diɲɛ fan kura dɔ fɛ - kana tabolo ɲɔgɔn kunbɛn kɔlɔlɔ kɛ bolokɔfɛ fɛn ye.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Woyasikɛla basigilen ani seba camaw ma se k'u yɛrɛ sɔrɔ ka da jamana taganyɛfɛ woyasi tabolo kuraw kan, yɔrɔmina tabolo fitiniw degiliw be fara ɲɔgɔnkan teliyala.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala i ka tile fɔlɔw la, a ɲinin ka gɛrɛfɛ kosɛbɛ Erɔpu balolicogola ani otɛli, dumuniw ani sɛriwisi ɲumanw k'i dɛmɛ degilila.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Kana sunɔkɔ dilan kan walima sɛriwiyɛtiw duguma yɔrɔw la i tɛ minunw maara kunkokɔnɔna dɔn.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Nin i bena sigi kɛrɛma, nani sigili dilan ye walima jɔ walasa ka saw, buntɛniw ani o ɲɔgɔnaw gɛn ka bɔyi.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: I ka so fa nin kafe dunlen ba ye sɔkɔmada fɛ ani kamomili te lafiyalan dɔni sufɛ.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Nin i be sokɔnɔ konze la, waati b'i bolo ka mako do i yɛrɛla ani ka miniti dama damani ta ka fɛni kɛrɛnkɛrɛnle dɔ wili ka min.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Nin i beka taɲɛ santi, opɔrtinite in minɛ ka jirinɔnɔ walima jirinɔnɔ gosilen dɔ ɲagama ɲɔgɔna.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Lala i bena seka minfɛn nɔgɔmani dɔ kodɔn i be seka min dilan daraka la tumamina nin i segin na ka ta i ka diɲɛ baarakɔrɔw la.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: In i balolen dugu dɔ kɔnɔ nin minfɛn camaw tabolo ye, ta bariw la walima minfɛn yɔrɔw gɛrɛfɛralaw la i tɛ ta minunw na.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Nin mɔgɔ minunw deli dɔkɔtɔrɔw ka kumakanw kan, daɲɛw yɛlɛmali ani minɛli tɛ kɔrɔ kelenw ye.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Bana yɛlɛmata ye bana ye min nati banakisɛ dɔ fɛ, inafɔ wirisuw, banakisɛ fitiniw, gololabanakisɛw walima banakisɛ tɔw.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Bana mɔgɔ minɛta ye bana ye min be yɛlɛma nɔgɔyala gɛrɛlila banabatɔ dɔ gɛrɛfɛ.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Gɔfɛrɛneman camaw b'a laɲinin lajɛlikɛlaw minun be dɔn fɛ, sigiba minunw be bɔ fɛ, jamanaw kɔnɔ k'u yɛrɛ boloci kabɔ bana dɔw ma.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Nin laɲininɲ sirileno waaticama lala jamanaw la woyasikɛla bɔra minunw la walima be fɛka ta minunw lajɛ.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Hakilina jɔlen kelen kabɔ Charlotte yɔrɔ, Caroline du Nord, ye ko a nafan ɲuman baw cogoya se denbayaw ma.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Yɔrɔ wɛrɛw sigibaw ye du teriya nisondiya fɔ waatidɔw la  inafɔ kun fɔlɔ ka ta yen, ani lajɛlikɛlaw be dugu in lajɛli nisondiya sɔrɔ nin denmisɛniw ye gɛrɛfɛ.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: San 20 tɛmɛni kɔ, denmisɛni teriya hakɛya cogow Uptown Charlotte kɔnɔ yɛlɛna kɔsɛbɛ kɔsɛbɛ.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Takisi be itilize waaticamana duw fɛ Charlotte kɔnɔ, ali na sɔrɔ u nafan be seka kɛ yi siratigɛ dɔw fɛ.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Sirisarizi beyi nin a tɛmɛ mɔgɔ fila kan, o la o cogoya in be seka gɛlɛya ka tɛmɛ a nafan kan.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica nĩkuo kũndũ kũrĩa kwĩ heho mũno thĩ ng'ima, na ĩthiũrũkĩirie South Pole.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Gũcera kũu kwĩ goro, kwendaga ucamba, kũngĩhanĩka tu mĩerinĩ ya summer Nov-Feb, na mũngĩcerio o Peninsula, islands na Ross Sea.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Andũ ngiri ciganona aruti wĩra nĩmaikaraga gũkũ ihinda rĩa summer thĩini wa kambĩ mĩrongo ĩtano; andũ anini nĩmaikaraga kũu ngina ihinda rĩa winter.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antarctica thĩ nyũmũ ni njaraganu na ikaarirwo 2-3 km nĩ barabu.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Rĩmwe nĩkũrĩ aceri ngũthi a rĩerainĩ nĩmathiaga thĩ nyũmũ kũhaba irĩma na gũkinya Pole, ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo na kambĩ nene.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (walima siraba) ye sira kilomɛtiri 1600 ye kabɔ McMurdo Station Ross Sea sanfɛ ka ta Poli fɛ.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: O ye nɛzi faralen ye ɲɔgɔnkan nin digɛnw minunw falen o ani tamasiyɛnlen no nin dirapow ye. O woyasi be seka kɛ nin tirakitɛri kɛrɛnkɛrɛnlenw ye, jiri samataw nin taji ani fɛnw ye.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: U ma makan kosɛbɛ, ola sira janya ka tɛmɛ Transantartic Mountains gɛrɛfɛ walasa ka ta kulu la.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Sirabakasara kosi kodɔnlen baw nɛnɛ fɛ ye sira tɛrɛntɛnlen ye, sena tamasiraw ani kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala tamasiraw.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Fitini fɔlila, i mako be samara la nin jo ɲuman ye. Tilema samaraw be tɛrɛntɛn waaticama kosɛbɛ gilasi ani nɛzi sanfɛ, ali nɛnɛ samarabaw dɔw de sɔn.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Sira kan ka dunya fitini, milimɛtiri 5 (1/5 puse) walima cama, ani dilanfɛn mankama fitini nɛnɛ waatiw la.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Kiranpɔn be samaraba dɔw la ani kiranpɔn farakan dɔ beyi tɛrɛntɛn waatiw la, min ben samaraw ani samarabaw camaw ma, o talɔnw walima talɔnw ani samarajuw.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Talɔnw kan ka surunya ani boɲa. Cɛncɛn, bɛlɛ walima kɔkɔ (kiloridi de kalisiyɔmu)be yɛrɛkɛ waatidɔw la gudɔrɔn walima siraw kan walasa ka samali taɲɛ.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Nɛzi benw ye fɛn ye min tɛ nɔrimali ye; sira yɛlɛkajigi garolen be seka sumayalikɛ, ani hakɛya  damatɛmɛlen  bena ben inafɔ nɛzi benw.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Kunbalan ye min ye ko nɛzi be kole, ola o mako fɛn dɔw la ka jigin, ani nɛzi dɔw jiginli be seka kunw ye ka tɔw ben.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Waatidɔwla, benli kun ye tile kɛli ye ka nɛzi kalaya, waatidɔw la nɛzi benw camaw, waatidɔw la kun gansanw, waatidɔw la adamaden dɔ.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Fiyɛnkolɔn ye fiyɛn fitini munu munata ye, min be gɛrɛfɛyɔrɔ fiyɛn sama kado kɔnɔ ani kɔɔfɛ.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: U be fiyɛn baw nati (waatidɔw la kilomɛtiri 100-200 lɛrila) ani be seka fɛn giramaw kɔrɔtan fiyɛn la, k'u ta ka ta tumamina fiyɛn kolɔn be bɔ a nɔna.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: U be daminɛ inafɔ antonurayi ka jigin kabɔ kabakolow fiyɛn la, ani be kɛ "fiyɛn kolɔn" ye tumamina u be maka tugumakolola.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Kelen ŊPN (kelena erezo dugulen) di baw ye sira ɲumanba ye ka panli ye politiki baliliw ani feere ɛntɛrɛnɛti tamasiyɛnw sɛnsɛnli kuna.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: U be ɛntɛrɛni tamasiyɛn jatedenw ɲɛ kun camaw na: u ɛntɛrɛniti siraw bɛɛ fale, min tɛ http dɔrɔn ye.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: U be waaticama ɛntɛriniti kunafoniw tɛmɛ ta hakɛw cama di ani sɛriwisi ɲuman ba, Kɔdi b'ula ani ola ka gɛlɛ ka nafikiya.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Kunafoni di baarakɛyɔrɔ be tilen ka kalɔn tikɛ nin kun lna, fɔlila ko a dabɔra ka "suyɛnli kunbɛ".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Tiɲɛla, maarayɔrɔw kɔdiw tɛ kɔlɔlɔ foyi nati kopiyeli kɔnlen la; fitini fitini disiki dɔ kopiyeli be zuye kaɲɛ cogoyala aparɛlanfɛn dɔ la yɔrɔ mina a yɛrɛ yɛrɛ bena zuye.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Nin kun ye ka se di baarakɛyɔrɔw ma u ka sukuw kuna; a bɛɛ be tɔnɔ sɔrɔ kuna.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Bari weleliw sira be yɛlɛma ɛntɛrɛnɛti sanfɛ, i mako tɛ nɛgɛjuru baarakɛyɔrɔ dɔ itilize min b'i ka yɔrɔ la walima i be ka woyase ka ta yɔrɔmina.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Jagoyalen tɛ fɛnɛ ka maarayɔrɔ nɛgɛjuru dɔ ta kabɔ i be ka balo kulu min cɛra la; i be seka sateliti ɛntɛrɛnɛti konɛkisiyɔn sɔrɔ Chicken, Alaska kunkokɔnɔnaw la ani ka nɛgɛjuru dɔ sugandi min b'a jira k'i be Arizona tile la.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Waatidɔwla, i kan ka nɛgɛjuru san a dana min be weleli kɛ diɲɛ fan bɛɛ fɛ, min ba to PSTN telefɔniw be sek'i wele. Nɛgɛjuru be bɔ yɔrɔ min be danfara kɛɛ mɔgɔ minunw bek'i wele la.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Sinsan sinsan kanbayɛlɛmalan apilikasiyɔn - apilikasiyɔn minunw be seka gafe fanw baw bayɛlɛma yɔrɔnikelen kabɔ kan dɔla ka ta kan wɛrɛla.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Apilikasiyɔn dɔw nin bɔnda in kɔnɔ be seka masalabolow bayɛlɛma kɔfɛ kanw la tamasiyɛnw walima fɛn wɛrɛw kuna diɲɛ kɔnɔ nin a baaralikɛba ye telefɔni ɲɛsin fɛnw dɔw ma.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Kan bayɛlɛma mansiw talaɲɛ kosɛbɛ kosɛbɛ, ani be waatidɔw la kanbayɛlɛmali ɲuman di cogodɔla (ani cogoya gɛlɛna mana manakan), nka jateminɛ dɔw mako beyi, inafɔ u be sek'a bɛɛ ɲagamu fɛnɛ.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Apilikasiyɔn ba kelen nin bɔnda in na ye Google kanbayɛlɛmala ye, min kanyɛlɛmali danga ɛntɛrɛni kɔfɛ tumamina nin ye kan kunafoniw ɲininlen terisarize.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Yɔrɔɲinin apilikasiyɔn itilizeli i ka telefɔnila be seka kɛ sira nɔgɔmani ani lafiyalen b ye ka yala tumamina nin t'i ka jamana kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: A be seka t'i be waari mara nin kariti sani ye GPS kama, walima GPS jɔlen a yɛrɛ ye walima kelen luweli mɔbili luwe baarakɛɛda dɔ fɛ.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Nin ɛntɛrɛnɛti kiredi t'i kun telefɔnila, walima nin a tɛ sɔn o yɔrɔla, u ka baarakaɲɛ be ka dɔgɔya walima tɛ sɔrɔ.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Butuki wɔniw bɛɛ faleno telefɔni pisi pirepeye aranze ɲagamuniw la min be seka itilize telefɔni kirediman saralenw la walima telefɔni gansanw.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Ali na sɔrɔ pisiw camaw kaɲi walasa ka weleli kɛ yɔrɔ bɛɛ la, dɔw sipesiyalizeleno wele nɔgɔmani dilila piriw la ka jamana kulu kɛrɛnkɛrɛni dɔw la.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Sirasɔrɔli nin sɛriwisi dɔw la ye waatidɔw la tɛmɛli nɛgɛjuru sira folama fɛ min be seka wele kabɔ telefɔniw camaw la ka sɔrɔ ima dɔrɛ bɔɔ,
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Sariyaw ka ɲɛsin fototama be apilike fɛnɛ widewo anrizisitilela, lala ali min ka c'o ye.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Nin fɛn dɔ fototali ma daga, ola i man ka miri ali k'a filime,
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Nin beka durɔni dɔ itilize, a sɛgɛsɛgɛ jɔna ka bila nin a dagaleno ka fɛn min filime ani sɛbɛn minunw walima jɛndili wɛrɛw minunw kan ka ɲinin.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Duroni pani ayeropɔri dɔ walima jamamayɔrɔ kuna tɛ waaticama hakili ɲumanw ye, ali nin a dagaleno i ka maarayɔrɔla.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Bibi nin na, sanfɛ woyasi sigiyɔrɔ marali ka gɛlɛ pankuru baarakɛyɔrɔw fɛ kasɔrɔ ɲɛɲininli ma kɛ fɔlɔ ani piri sumani.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Waatidɔw la, piri baw camaw be seka kɛ woli kelen kɔnɔ kunafonisow camaw la ani ɲininli jaabi sumani ye ɲɔgɔna be sara kaɲɛ ani ka pankuruso baarakɛyɔrɔ ka ɛntɛrɛnɛti siti lajɛ fɛnɛ yani marali cɛ kabila.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Ali na sɔrɔ i mako tɛna se wiza ma lajɛli fitiniw la jamana dɔw la inafɔ turisi walima baara okumu kɔnɔ, tagali yen inafɔ kɔfɛ kalanden waaticamala mako toli kuntalajan la ka tɛmɛ tagali yen dɔrɔ inafɔ tile damadɔni turisi.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: bakurubala, tolila kɔfɛ jamana fɛnw fɛnw kɔnɔ waatikuntalajan la bena ɲinin i fɛ ka wiza ɲinin ka bila.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: kalanden wizaw ɲininli fɛnw tɛ kelen waaticamala ani a sɔrɔli baaraw turisiw gansanw fɛ walima baarakɛ wizaw.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Jamana camaw fɛ, i mako be se jɛndili sɛbɛn ma kabɔ kalanyɔrɔ i be fɛ kana kalankɛ yɔrɔ mina, ani waari pirewu k'i si yɛrɛ kɔrɔ san kelen boɲɔgɔngola i ka kalan kɔnɔ.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: kunafoni fɛrɛfɛsiyalenw lajɛ nin kalanyɔrɔ ye, ani jamana imigirasiyɔn baarakɛyɔrɔ bɔnda i be fɛka ta kalan kɛ yɔrɔmina.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Fo nin ye lasigiden ye, min be baara kɔkan waaticamala kɔrɔ ye ko i bena sɔrɔ takisi sara jamana la i sigilen min kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Sɔrɔ takisi dilaneno cogoyacamaw la jamana camaw la, ani takisi waariw ani bɔndaw be yɛlɛma cogoya bala kabɔ jamana dɔ la ka ta jamana dɔ la.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Jamana kulu dɔw kɔnɔ, inafo Etazini ani Kanada, sɔrɔ takisi be bɔ jamana kulu yɔrɔ la ani maara yɔrɔ la, ola waariw and bɔndaw be seka yɛlɛma kabɔ maarayɔrɔ dɔla ka ta maarayɔrɔ dɔ wɛrɛ la.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Ali na sɔrɔ imigirasiyɔn mɔgɔw ka lajɛliw tɛ yi waaticamana walima ye tɔgɔ dɔrɔn de ye tumamina nin i sera i ka jamanala, duwanɲɛ ka lajɛliw be seka kɛ gɛlɛya ye.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: D'ala k'i ba dɔn min ani min tɛ seka dɔn ani fɛnw bɛɛ kofɛ minunw tɛmɛleno sariya danakan.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Sira nɔgɔmani ba ka woyasi sɛbɛni baaraw daminɛ ye k'i ka dɔniya taɲɛ ɛntɛrɛnɛti sanfɛ woyasi bulɔgi siti jɔlen dɔ kan.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Tumanina nin i degila sɛbɛni sɛbɛn kɛcogoya ani sɛbɛn kɛliw la ɛntɛrɛnɛti sanfɛ, ola kɔfɛ, i be sekana lala i yɛrɛ ka ɛntɛrɛnɛti siti dilan,
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Alakamabaarakɛli tumamina nin be woyasila ye sira ɲumanba ye ka danfara bɔ nka o tɛ dili dɔrɔn kuna.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Baloli ani alakamabaarakɛli jamana wɛrɛla ye sira ɲumanba ye ka tabolo wɛrɛ dɔn, mɔgɔ kura dɔn, k' yɛrɛ dɔn, ka yecogo wɛrɛ famuya ani ali ka se kuraw sɔrɔ.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: O be seka fɛnɛ sira ɲuman ye k'i ka waarimaralen sama ka ta ɲɛfɛ k'i ka toli janya cogoyadɔla bari alakamabaaraw camaw be so ani dumuni d'ima ani dama damaniw be sara fitini di.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikings kun ye Russie jisiraw itilize ka Black Sea la ani Caspian Sea. Nin sira fan dɔw be seka itilize alisa, Jɛndili sɛbɛnw ɲinin lala min mako beyi, min sɔrli be seka gɛlɛya lala.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: White Sea - Baltic Canal be Artic Ocean ani Baltic Sea tuguɲɔgɔna, nin tɛmɛli ye Ladoga ani Saint Petersburg fɛ, cogoyala nin baw ani lakiw ye.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Laki Onega fɛnɛ tuguleno fɛnɛ Ŋolga la, ola nalila kabɔ Caspian Sea ka tɛmɛ Russie be seka kɛ alisa.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: D'ala kafɔ ko waatimina nin batɔn jɔ yɔrɔw la fɛn bɛɛ bena jɛya kaɲɛ kosɛbɛ. I bena batɔn ɲinin na wɛrɛw ben ani u bena u ka kuanfoni d'ima.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Fitinifɔlila, i bena kunafoni bila dɛmɛdilila, nin dɔnisarize yɔrɔ tamali, gɛlɛrila mɔgɔw la k'u ka yaciw jɔsi, kumaɲininlila mɔgɔw jisanfɛ baarakɛlaw fɛ minɛnfɛn miriyɔrɔla, dɔ wɛrɛ.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: A ɲinin ka kuma mɔgɔ camaw fɛ nin o be seka kɛ. Waati fitiniw tɛmɛni kɔfɛ bɛɛ bi n'i dɔn ani bena kunafonow d'ima batɔn minunw be mɔgɔ ɲinina kuna.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: I kan k'i ka pɔnyin sɔrɔ pankuru kulu sugandi ɲamajɔla.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Ali na sɔrɔ i be seka miri k'o ye miriya ɲuman ye ka ta pankuruso la i be woyase mina ka caya, i kan ka dɔ ko tɔnɔn minunw di tɛ kelen ye waatidɔw la ani pankuruta waatibɛ pɔnyin be seka kɛ ɲuman ye pankuruso dɔ wɛrɛla o kulu kelen kɔnɔ.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Pankurusow inafɔ Emirates, Etihad, Airways, Quatar Airways and Turkish Airways y'u ka sɛriwisiw bɔɲa kosɛbɛ ka ɲɛsin Farafina ma, ani be tuguliw kɛ ka ta Farafina dugu baw la nin piri nɔgɔmaniw ye ka tɛmɛ Erɔpu pankurusow kan.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines be ta yɔrɔ 39 de la Farafina duguw 30 kɔnɔ inafɔ san 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Nin woyasi waati wɛrɛ b'i bolo, a ɲinin ka lajɛ cogomina i ka tike waari faralenɲɔgɔn kan ka ta Farafina be suma nin diɲɛɛ turu kɛli tike waariw ye.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Kana ɲina ka wiza waari fara depansi wɛrɛ kan, tali takisi, tuma tiransipɔri, dɔ wɛrɛ nin yɔrɔ ninunw bɛɛla Farafina kɔfɛ.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: In i be fɛka woyase pankuru kɔnɔ diɲɛ fan bɛɛ worodugu emisifɛri kɔnɔ, pankuru woyasiw ani yɔrɔw danbɔleno ko sababu kɛɛ kɔkɔjiw siraw tugubali ye ɲɔgɔna.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Pankuruso kulu si tɛ kɔkɔji sabaw bɛɛ tikɛ worodugu emisifɛri la (ani SkyTeam tɛ ni tikɛli si kɛ).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Nka, Star Alliance be ta fan bɛɛ foka ɲinbɔ Pasifiki kɔrɔn an'a worodugu yanfan la kabɔ Santiago de Chilie ka ta Tahiti, min LATAM Oneworld ka wɔli ye.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Woyasi pankurula dɔrɔn teyi nin i be fɛka pan Pasifiki Worodugu yanfan kuna ani Ameriki di Sud jida tileben yanfan kan. (a lajɛ duguma).
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: San 1994, Azerbajan maarayɔrɔ Armenie-Nagoro-Karabakh siyakuku ye kɛlɛ tikɛ Azeriw la.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Nin Amernie ka jukɔrɔma dɔndɔnli ye, jamana kura dɔ dilana. Nka, jamana jɔlen si, ali Armenie yɛrɛ - ma sɔn k'a kodɔn kɛnɛna.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Politiki `mankanw maarayɔrɔ kuna be bek'alisa Armenie ani Azerbajan ka  cɛw cɛn.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Canal District (Olandɛkana: Grachtengordel) ye siyɛkili 17 nan dugu ye min kɛnino ka Binnenstad min be Amsterdam munu mun.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Dugu in bɛɛ jiraleno inafɔ UNESCO Diɲɛ Cɛnma Yɔrɔ ko sababu ka k'a ladala ani tariku nafan kelen ye, ani a sow walɛri be jamana so walɛribaw cɛla.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre. min kɔrɔ ye Dugu Duuruw, minunw ye jidala wulakɔnɔna fitini duuruw ye kabɔ Riomaggiore, Manarola, Nernazza ani Monterosso min be Italie Liguria maarayɔrɔla.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: U tɔgɔ sɛbɛnleno UNESCO Diɲɛ Cɛn lisila.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Siyɛkili tɛmɛlenw kɔnɔ, mɔgɔw ye jateminɛlila terasiw jɔw dugukolo jalen ani garonin sanfɛ fo kuluw la min ɲɛsinleno kɔkɔji ma.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Nin cɛɲan fan dɔ ye sɔrɔ taɲɛ baliya ye. Siraw, tirɛnw ani batɔnw be wulakɔnɔnaw tukuɲɔgɔna, ani mɔbiliw tɛ sek'u sɔrɔ kabɔ kɔfɛ.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Faransɛ suguyaw  minunw be fɔ Belgique kɔnɔ ani Suisse danbɔnleno cogoya fitinila faransɛ min be fɔ Faransi kɔnɔ, ali n'u ka surun ɲɔgɔna fitini famuyalila.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Kɛrɛnkɛrɛniyala, jate cogoya Belgique faransɛ la ani Suisse ta danfara bɔleno Faransi t'a la dɔni, ani daɲɛ dɔw fɔli tɛ kelen ye dɔni.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Nka, Belgique ani Suisse faransɛfɔlaw bena seka faransɛ nɔrɔmali kalan kalansola, ola u bena sek'i famuya ali nin i ye faransɛ nɔrɔmali jate cogoya itilize.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Diɲɛ fan camaw la, tikɛwili ye teriya wale ye, min be "ani ɲankuma" jira.
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Nka, Malaisie kɔnɔ, kɔni malɛw cɛla burusi kɔnɔnaw la, o kɔrɔ ye "na yan" ka surun digɛndɛnɛ deni naanina kuruli kana farikolo fanfɛ, wale min be nati Ɛrɔpu jamana dɔw kɔn, ani kan ka itilize o kun dɔrɔn de kama.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Surunyakumala, Grande Bretagne woyasikɛlaw  Ɛsipaɲi kɔnɔ be seka fili tikɛwili kanbɛn miny tikɛkɔnɔna silinye folibama (ka tɛmɛ tikɛ beka wili mɔgɔ mina) inafɔ seginli waleya.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Gɛrɛfɛ kanw ye kan dilaniw minunw dilana walasa ka kuma waleya nɔgɔya mɔgɔw nin ɲɔgɔncɛ min bena kunbalan sɔrɔ kuma siratigɛ fɛ.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: U danbɔɔleno forobakanla, mɔgɔ ma min dilan walima kɔnɔna kanw min bena kɛ kan min sera tɔw ye kun kelen na walima kun wɛrɛ inafɔ kuma siraw kan wɛrɛw fɔbaw nin ɲɔgɔncɛ.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Funteni dɔn la, woyasikɛlaw be seka  hakili wasu wasu ye min bena jira ola ko ji beyi (walima fɛn wɛrɛ).
